svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: EPOS application architecture
svg.desc: End-to-end architecture of the EPOS engineering portfolio intelligence prototype: React and TypeScript single-page application, FastAPI REST API, security layer, service adapters, deterministic Python engines, SQLModel persistence over SQLite or PostgreSQL, governed AI explanation layer, and the CI build and quality pipeline.
svg.text: System overview · browser, API, governed analytics, databases and optional AI
▼ Down arrows = a request travelling inward
▲ Up arrows = the validated response returning
Dashed = configuration, build or reference input
The server enforces access, never hidden UI
Synthetic data · no enterprise data connectors
Injected as environment secrets · never exposed to client
AI unavailable → all calculations still work
API unreachable → explicit error state in UI
Internal factor keys never reach the screen
Every result carries its source record IDs
The analysis reference date is always shown
Kept runnable for continuity; excluded from the
packaged deployment, which serves React only.
Fictional projects, people and records only. No real
customer, employee or employer data is present.
Browser access · backend credentials stay private
Renders API responses only — no scoring, risk or forecast logic runs in the browser, and no database URL, signing key or AI key ever reaches the client.
Projects, risks, stage gates, scenarios, copilot
Serves compiled client bundle & UI assets
OpenAPI standard; disabled publicly in production
Routers never calculate business results — every scored answer is delegated to the service layer and the deterministic engines.
Converts database rows into engine inputs
Translates internal factor keys to display labels
Classifies user intent and validates entity IDs
Authorised search, activity log and user admin
Delay what-if that never mutates data
Weights, bands and thresholds are centrally governed · results cite source records · every calculation uses an explicit analysis date and never writes data.
Type-safe Python models define table schema
Bound parameters separate SQL from values
Automated tests run on isolated throwaway instances
Enforced durable storage in production mode
Hosted mode requires PostgreSQL · production startup migrations are disabled by default and managed separately.
Portfolio access · project updates · risk management
Change decisions · scenario analysis · AI assistance
Compiled by Vite · served directly by the API
by the API as a single unified service origin.
2 · Check row version and record the audit event
Structured JSON · not deterministic model output
Cannot write records, run SQL, calculate a score or
approve anything. Output is labelled a draft for
human review before any decision is taken.
Idempotent DDL & Synthetic Starter Data Scripts
Migrations run as a pre-deployment step, preventing
concurrent cloud instances from racing on schema locks.
Services access the database directly; calculation engines stay independent of storage.
Git · Automated CI Runners · Locked Dependencies
Pytest unit, engine, API & RBAC suite
Validates schema upgrades to head revision
Synthetic data only · verified locally and in CI · PostgreSQL deployment path implemented, no live production deployment is claimed.
AI-generated decision-support draft; human review required.
